title: More text models, more room for requests
summary:
New text model options and a higher request limit arrived alongside a fix for non-Latin image prompts and a book of artistic styles.

The text API added `claude-hybridspace` and `qwen-coder`, and switched `llamalight` to Llama 3.1 8B Instruct. The 56,000-character input limit now applies only to `openai`, and the text API rate limit rose from 40 to 200 requests per minute.

Image prompt sanitization now preserves Persian and other non-Latin characters instead of stripping them out. Control characters are still removed, and tests cover translated prompts and image-generation parameters.

An interactive book showcasing more than 90 Pollinations-generated artistic styles was added to the homepage and README tutorials lists, with HTML and PDF versions linked.

daily.title: Claude Hybridspace joins text
daily.text: Use `claude-hybridspace` for text requests, routed to Claude 3.5 Haiku. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-hybridspace).

daily.title: Qwen Coder joins text
daily.text: Try Qwen 2.5 Coder 32B through the `qwen-coder` model ID. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-coder).

daily.title: Llamalight changes models
daily.text: `llamalight` now uses Llama 3.1 8B Instruct via Scaleway. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llamalight).

daily.title: Text input limit narrows
daily.text: The 56,000-character input limit now applies only to the `openai` model, rather than every text model. [Explore the API](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
